rbf_capacity_posthoc.scope: Post-hoc exact finite LP diagnostic: whether fixed Gaussian logits can concentrate on each binary pattern, not a Bayesian optimality test

probability.interpretation_guard: An optimizer success flag only means the declared numerical optimizer terminated successfully; it does not establish posterior correctness. Weak and initialization results are post-hoc diagnostics and do not replace frozen v2.

config.scope: 2D scalar; two fixed Gaussian components; known loss ratio; fixed common ROI initialization; half receive/full transmit aperture; independent grid and quadrature

manifold_v3.paired_note: Each family/budget cell retains one value per shared 10-case seed for each method. Missing means no recorded history point at or below that budget; no interpolation was used.
manifold_v3.terminal_cost_note: Terminal actual RHS and seconds are reported separately because methods often terminate at different RHS; this is not described as equal-RHS comparison.
